# Stale fixtures: cases whose expectations predate a rule eevm implements.
# A listed case that fails is reported as "stale", not as a failure, so it never
# belongs in known_failures.txt. Same line format as known_failures.txt; list
# whole tests (file#name), never files or directories, so other forks of the
# same file still count.
#
# Prague BlockchainTests of the pinned ethereum/tests snapshot (afed83bf,
# "refill all pyspec tests with prague", 2025-02-19) were filled before the
# final EIP-7002/EIP-7251 rule that a block is invalid when either request
# contract has no code. Their pre-state leaves both contracts out, so eevm
# rejects their first block with :system_contract_empty, as mainnet clients do.
# Upstream refilled them with the contracts in ethereum/tests 3129f16519
# ("refill all prague using latest evmone", 2025-05-09):
# https://github.com/ethereum/tests/commit/3129f16519
# EEST fixtures are the authoritative Prague suite.
